old: Thee for food, thee for strength. You are winds. Let god Savitṛ impel you to the most excellent work. Swell, O inviolable cows, as Indra's share, rich in offspring, free from disease, free from consumption. Let no thief, nor any evil-wisher, have power over you. May you be many and steadfast with this lord of cattle. Protect the sacrificer's cattle.
new: Thee for food, thee for strength. You are winds. Let god Savitṛ impel you to the most excellent work. May you be many and steadfast with this lord of cattle. Protect the sacrificer's cattle.
